Genesis.title: Genesis
Genesis.author: Traditionally attributed to Moses.
Genesis.date: Commonly placed during Israel's wilderness period.
Genesis.historicalSetting: Records the beginnings of creation, humanity, sin, nations, and God's covenant relationship with Abraham and his descendants.
Genesis.christFocus: The promised Seed who will crush the serpent and bring blessing to the nations.

John.title: John
John.author: Traditionally attributed to John the Apostle.
John.date: Generally dated near the end of the first century.
John.audience: Believers and seekers desiring to know Jesus Christ.
John.historicalSetting: Written to present Jesus as the Son of God and lead readers to faith in Him.
themes: Jesus as the Son of God
John.christFocus: Jesus Christ revealed as the eternal Word made flesh.

Romans.title: Romans
Romans.author: Paul the Apostle.
Romans.historicalSetting: Written before Paul's journey to Jerusalem to explain the Gospel and strengthen the church.
Romans.christFocus: Jesus Christ as the righteousness of God revealed to sinners.
